rounds.name: Worker-Kerr
rounds.text:
Worker-Kerr has only kept faith in 2 of 10 recent dealings, indicating a high likelihood of cutting corners. To incentivize proper work, withholding pay is the safer choice, as it offers a higher reward (5 tasks) if they do the job correctly.  

ACTION: WITHHOLD

rounds.text:
